title: The item dispatch — coordinator-session.sh argv, the --item grammar, the exit contract, the admission it leads to
description: Machine half of dispatch.md. `argv` is what coordinator-scan.sh passes; `argv_redrawn` is the target shape with no model (⚑ gap until the gateway defer replaces the scan's rail probe).

model.description: ⚑ gap — sent today (coordinatorModel or an opencode-go/<id>); absent from argv_redrawn

wip.description: ADR-097 AGENT_WIP_LIMIT for the item's repo; 1 on probe failure

argv_redrawn.description: The redrawn contract: identity + launcher-owned parameters only; the tier is derived from the clause by the admission, not chosen by the scan.

exit.description: coordinator-session.sh exit codes as the scan reads them.

oneOf.description: pod created (and Ready under --detach) — the lane counts as dispatched
usage refusal — no pod (missing repo=/item=, non-inert --launch token, mutually exclusive modes)
a racing dispatcher holds the (repo, item) key — the scan marks the unit tried and walks on
any other failure — the scan flushes class rows and exits with this code

admission.description: In-pod admission of the item session's LLM, through the launch island's gateway-admit.sh → gateway POST /sessions (gateway/specs/endpoints/sessions.schema.json is the owner of the wire shapes).

stack.description: ⚑ gap — only the platform stack admits through the gateway today

launch.description: The --launch argv of a noop-rerun pod: agents/agent-session.sh's fix-round line, every token shell-inert.
